name: com.uee03.pretzel.sfx
description: Sound effects by name on top of Pretzel Audio: an SfxLibrary asset of ids to audio cues, a player that rate-limits and caps concurrent voices per sound, and a ready pack of generated game sounds.

samples.description: Thirteen generated sounds (UI, pickups, hits, explosion, stingers) wired into an SfxLibrary, with a sound board scene.
